g.text: Family Fanous – body, all parts (فانوس العيلة)
PROTOTYPE – not for production until the workshop confirms material thickness, joint fit and LED dimensions
نموذج أولي – ليس للإنتاج قبل تأكيد الورشة لسُمك الخامة وتركيب الوصلات ومقاس الـ LED
Overall 134 × 134 × 300 mm (W × D × H, feet to top of ring) · body 116 × 116 × 194 · base 24 · cap 3 · dome 46 · ring Ø26
Plaque 96 × 133 mm · blank NAME AREA 65 × 45 mm (dashed, NOTES) · 36 parts · 3 mm plywood (MDF also works)
Parameters: thickness 3 mm · slot 3.1 mm · kerf 0.15 mm · min web 3 mm · LED 40 × 20 mm (pocket Ø41)
Scale 1:1, units mm. Layers: CUT red #ff0000 0.1 mm · ENGRAVE black fill · SCORE blue · NOTES grey (do not output). Regenerate: node scripts/lantern-drawings.js --thickness 3 --slot 3.1 --kerf 0.15
LED pocket ring (on the base plate) · 53 × 53
Base skirt FRONT (feet at the ends) · 128 × 24
Base skirt BACK (feet at the ends) · 128 × 24
Base skirt LEFT (feet at the ends) · 128 × 24
Base skirt RIGHT (feet at the ends) · 128 × 24
Bayonet lug-space layer (under the base plate, laser side UP) · 74 × 74
Bayonet lock layer (under the lug-space layer) · 74 × 74
Hatch 1: lug disc (top, the LED sits on it) · 55.4 × 53.5
Hatch 3: grip disc (engraving faces DOWN; arrow = lock) · 65.8 × 65.8
